ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "09 Closed DQ"), ISCHANGED(StageName), CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)), "02 Solution Alignment", 1, "03 Solution Validation", 2, "04 Proposal", 3, "05 Negotiation", 4, "06 Signed Contract Received", 5 ,0) >= 2 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An opportunity cannot be moved to Closed-DQ after it has reached Solution Alignment. Please update closed status to Closed-Lost
